spans.s: श्लिकु (I) m. 1. A libertine, a debauchee; 2. a slave, a dependant.
श्लिक्यु m. 1. A servant; 2. a libertine.

श्लिष् (II) vt. 4P (pp. श्लिष्ट; pres. श्लिष्यति) 1. To embrace, श्लिष्यति कामपि चुंबति कामपि कामपि रमयति रामाम् Git.G.i.; 2. to adhere, to cling to; 3. to unite, to join.With आ-, to embrace.With उप-, to embrace.With वि-, to burst, शरबंधा विशिश्लिषुः Bt.xiv.67; 2. to be separated, Megh.i.7.With सम्-, to adhere to, to cling to.
श्लिष् (III) vt. 10U (pres. श्लेषयति-ते) To connect, to unite.
श्लिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Adhered to, clung to; 2. leaning on; 3. embraced; 4. susceptible of a double interpretation (in rhetoric).
श्लिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Adhered to, clung to; 2. leaning on; 3. embraced; 4. susceptible of a double interpretation (in rhetoric).
श्लील a. (f. ला) The same as श्रील q.v.
श्लील a. (f. ला) The same as श्रील q.v.
